Who you listen to matters more than any title.

Kevin explains a simple test: listen to someone who has what you want and has been where you are. He reads out a list of impressive-sounding job titles and shrugs at each one, because a certificate is easy to get.

What counts, he says, is real knowledge built from personal experience and deep research in real life, not just theory.

Which matters more to you: the title or the experience?
